messages:
leigh: Heads-up — scheduling a Graceful Degrade v0.9 dry-run for dedicated pools this Sat 01:00-03:00 UTC. Goal: validate request-level throttling, degraded-model routing, and client-facing retry guidance without changing default routing behavior. TL;DR: enable throttle flags in test mode, mirror degraded-model traffic, run synthetic error/latency spike, validate alerts + client message templates.

omar: Why v0.9 dry-run? Last mile is the client UX and we want to confirm reduced tail latency without large customer-visible errors.

leigh: Exact plan: 00:40 preflight checks, 01:00 enable degrade flags (mirror + shadow routing), 01:10 synthetic latency spike (tagged as enterprise and standard), 01:25 enable soft-throttle (leaky-bucket @ 120 req/s per-tenant), 01:40 engage degraded-model mirror (75% mirrored), 02:00 observe + escalate if triggers, 02:30 controlled ramp down, 03:00 postmortem and customer messaging draft. Rollback triggers: sustained p99 > 320ms for 5m, error rate > 0.8% for 5m, or tail model CPU > 90% for 3m. Soft triggers will pause ramp and flip to fallback route. Runbook: https://intranet.redwood/sre/runbooks/graceful-degrade-dryrun (please update)

tasha: Throttle snippet for gateway config:
```
throttle_policy "per_tenant_leaky" {
  key: header(x-tenant-id)
  rate: 120rps
  burst: 40
  mode: soft  # soft = queue a small backlog + return Retry-After 50ms
}
```
We return 429 with Retry-After for throttled requests and log retry-metadata.

ben: Degraded-model routing example (mirror-only for dry-run):
```
route "degrade-test" {
  match: header(x-client-capabilities) != "strict-correctness"
  mirror: pool("degraded-model-2x")
  mirror_rate: 0.75
}
```
We'll not change primary weights.

sre-bot: Maintenance scheduled: graceful-degrade-dryrun by leigh on 2456789012 (Sat 01:00-03:00 UTC). Notified groups: eng-sre, eng-runtime, product, support.

leigh: Observability checklist (short): - create dryrun.* metric namespace - synthetic probes from us-east, eu-west, ap-south - 100% trace sample for mirrored requests for first 30m - create 'degrade-p99' and 'throttle-429' panels - set alert: dryrun.degrade-p99 > 280ms for 3m (soft) and >320ms for 5m (hard).

omar: Client guidance: support will publish a short retry guide recommending exponential backoff with jitter and a 3-retry limit when seeing 429s. I'll draft canned text for support channels.

tasha: Loadtest commands for teams wanting to participate:
```
# run from loadtest cluster with tenant tagging
./tools/loadtest --duration 20m --qps 800 --header "x-tenant-id: demo-enterprise" --header "x-client-capabilities: relaxed" --tag degrade-dryrun-2024
```
We will run regionals at 01:05 and 01:35.

ben: Autoscaler tweak: mark degraded-model pool with scale.probe=true so mirrored load triggers real scaling during the test. I'll set min_instances +10% at 00:30.

leigh: Fallback behavior: on soft trigger we will pause ramps and shift mirror_rate -> 0.4 and enable per-tenant throttles for impacted tenants. On hard trigger we will remove mirror flag and revert any autoscaler overrides. Only jamie or leigh can execute full rollback.

sre-bot: Reminder 60m: graceful-degrade-dryrun starts in 60 minutes.

omar: I'll own observability for the window. @tasha please own gateway flags and proxy rollout. @ben you own autoscaler config.

tasha: ack — will post PR for flag and proxy rollout link here when ready.

ben: ack — will be on standby from 00:20-03:30 UTC.

leigh: Keep updates here during the window. Short statuses only (start/ok/problem/rollforward/rollback). Reactions to ack. :white_check_mark:
